verdict.rationale: Vue's docs only point to third-party tools for mobile (Ionic Vue, Quasar, Tauri), and none are described as producing native iOS/Android apps. The custom renderer API is a developer building block for non-DOM targets, not a shipped native mobile capability. A community comment notes Vue's native option, Weex, was not production ready. Neither path earns credit for Vue's own native-mobile capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse my framework skills and code to build performant native mobile apps for iOS and Android
